seo.title: aiOFFICE: orders and documents in one controlled process
seo.description: aiOFFICE turns incoming orders into checked drafts, routes them for human approval, and keeps records aligned across RS.ge and accounting tools.

hero.commitment: aiNOW maps one process, defines the approval points, and validates the result with the team before wider use.
hero.audience: For teams handling orders, documents, approvals and routine reconciliation.
hero.sub: A Viber order becomes a checked draft. A person approves it before any customer, accounting or tax action is ready.
hero.signedBy: aiNOW reviews the process on your data, configures the workflow, and documents the handover.

work.headingAccent: One controlled process at a time.
work.s1Desc: aiNOW follows the work from the first message to the final record and identifies every manual handoff.
work.s2Desc: The first scope covers one repeatable process, its source data, its destination and the result to review.
work.s3Desc: Each step has a visible state. Customer, money and tax actions remain drafts until an authorised person approves them.
work.s4Desc: Available interfaces and file exchanges are checked before the workflow is configured. Unsupported connections stay outside the scope.
work.s5Desc: Clear inputs, incomplete photos, mismatched records and approval paths are tested before routine use.
work.s6Desc: aiNOW records the workflow, access rules and support boundary so changes can be reviewed without hiding operational risk.

faq.subtitle: How aiOFFICE reduces manual work and where approval stays.
faq.a1: aiOFFICE is aiNOW's office automation product. It connects orders, waybills, invoices, approvals, and reports into one controlled process.
faq.a2: aiOFFICE fits companies where orders are scattered across Viber, WhatsApp, email, or spreadsheets and then copied by hand into accounting systems.
faq.q3: Does it connect to RS.ge, 1C, or ORIS?
faq.a3: Integration depends on your access and current system. In the safe mode, aiOFFICE creates a draft first and final actions require approval.
faq.a4: A human approves steps that change money, stock, tax documents, or customer obligations. That is part of the safety design.
faq.q5: What result does the business get?
faq.a5: The business gets less manual copying, fewer lost orders, and a process that shows who approved what, when, and why.
faq.q6: Can it prepare RS.ge waybills and invoices?
faq.a6: Supported data can be used to prepare document drafts. An authorised person reviews the draft before submission or posting.
faq.a7: Storage, access and deployment are defined in the project scope. Only the systems required for the agreed workflow are included.
faq.q8: What prevents an incorrect customer or tax action?
faq.a8: Sensitive actions stay in draft. A named employee approves them, and the ready state appears only after that approval.
faq.a9: aiOFFICE handles repetitive movement of information. Employees keep approval, exception handling and business decisions.
faq.q10: What happens when a source format changes?
faq.a10: The workflow stops unsafe steps and exposes the exception. Monitoring and the support response are defined in the operating scope.
faq.a11: Ownership, access, documentation and handover conditions are defined in the agreement before implementation starts.
faq.q12: Is a small team suitable for aiOFFICE?
faq.a12: Team size is not the main test. The useful signal is a repeatable process that moves the same information between people or systems.
faq.q13: How is value evaluated without speculative savings?
faq.a13: The project selects an operational measure such as missing orders, correction volume, processing delay or record mismatch and reviews it on real data.
faq.q14: Which aiNOW product fits the process?
faq.a14: aiOFFICE covers internal workflows. aiDOCS handles document-heavy work, aiSTAFF supports chat, and aiCALL supports phone workflows.

flow.heading: From Viber message to approved record

flow.handTime: Messages, checks and documents handled in separate steps
flow.autoTime: One visible flow with a human approval gate
flow.s1sub: A Viber voice note or photo enters the order queue
flow.s2sub: Customer, item and quantity fields are checked
flow.s3sub: The waybill and invoice remain drafts
flow.s4sub: An authorised employee reviews the draft and confirms the action
flow.s5sub: The approved record can move to the connected system
flow.note: Approval is the safety control: nothing becomes ready before an authorised person confirms it.

exceptionGuard.heading: The workflow stops instead of guessing
exceptionGuard.subtitle: A poor photo hides the quantity. aiOFFICE holds the order until a person confirms 12, then continues with that correction.
exceptionGuard.outcome: The confirmed quantity is used and processing continues

leak.heading: Estimate the cost of order errors and penalties

leak.viber: Share received by Viber, phone or photo
leak.note: The result changes only from the values entered here. It is a planning aid, not a forecast or guarantee.

reconciliationGuard.heading: Dispatch waits until all records match
reconciliationGuard.subtitle: The order, inventory and waybill show 12. Accounting shows 10, so dispatch remains blocked until the record is corrected.
reconciliationGuard.outcome: All four records match, so dispatch is ready

capabilities.title: What aiOFFICE handles in daily operations
capabilities.intro: Orders, checks, and documents without unnecessary manual copying.

1.title: Turns a message into a processed order
1.description: aiOFFICE reads the customer, products, and quantities from a Viber message and prepares the document drafts.
1.result: The team does not need to copy the order by hand.

2.title: Stops uncertain data
2.description: If a photo or quantity is unclear, the process pauses and asks an employee for the correct value.
2.result: Uncertain data does not quietly enter a document.

3.title: Shows the cost of manual work
3.description: Order volume, processing time, and current team cost appear in one simple view.
3.result: The business sees which process is worth automating first.

4.title: Checks records against each other
4.description: The order, stock, waybill, and accounting entry must match before the process continues.
4.result: A mismatch is found and corrected before sending.

5.title: Plans automation by priority
5.description: aiNOW reviews the business process and shows which repeated task should be simplified first.
5.result: The business starts with the clearest and most useful process.
